Name: Laputa Castle in the Sky Crystal Amulet (Ghibli) (CP)
Author: LorSnore
Description:
[size=2]Replaces the Mermaid Pendant graphics with the Crystal Amulet of Laputa from the Ghibli movie "Castle in the Sky"[/size]

[size=2]- [b]Requires [u][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/u] and [u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/u][/b]
- ﻿Partially edits springobjects.xnb for the Mermaid Pendant graphic
- Partially edits ObjectInformation.xnb for the English hover text of the item[/size]
[size=2]- Partially edits mail.xnb for the English text from marriage letter
- Optional Chinese translation by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/57877456-faraways/]FarAways[/url] enabled when the game language setting is "zh"/Chinese, English will still work by default
- [b]Install[/b] by downloading, [b]unzipping, [/b]and dragging the [b]unzipped[/b] folder to your Mods folder, the same one where you installed Content Patcher

[/size]
[size=3]Check out my other Ghibli mods!
[/size][size=4]-[/size] [size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2927]Secret Woods Totoro [/url](CP)
[size=4]-[/size][size=2] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2369]Jiji Pet Cat Replacement[/url]﻿ (CP)[/size]
